# Installed local MCP 0.6.11 filed memories

The companion fixture records four `inspect_memory` exchanges from the installer’s bundled engine. It uses the same local owner, project, initialization and eight-tool registration as the original golden. The engine’s admission, supersession and placement APIs create the source store with no inference provider or key.

The successor has two placements. One topic has advanced to revision 2 after a second member joined. The prior Memory retains a verbatim receipt and includes its replacement revision, current revision and receipt binding. The two ends of the contradiction expose the conflict in both directions. Inspect is the only tool on this profile that returns topic and relation records directly.

Replay preserves every request and reply field, including text block property order. Generated UUIDs and ISO timestamps use the original golden’s normalization, extended to topic IDs and supersession receipt ID arrays. References to the same generated ID use the same normalized value. The check seeds a fresh candidate through its storage ports. Qualification replays on a copy of the installed store and the attested migration of that same source.
